cal-cheese.title: Callebaut: Caramel cheesecake
cal-cheese.facts: Breton biscuit, caramel cream-cheese filling, salted caramel, gold-chocolate glaze; biscuit rolled to 4 mm.

cal-rasp.title: Callebaut: Kumabo raspberry mousse pastry
cal-rasp.facts: Chocolate sablé supports chocolate mousse; finish includes fresh raspberries and macarons.

cal-hazel.title: Callebaut: Hazelnut Crunch Entremet
cal-hazel.facts: Hazelnut biscuit, chocolate-hazelnut crunch, gianduja mousse, praline glaze; moulded and frozen before glazing.

cal-charm.title: Callebaut: Raspberry chocolate charm
cal-charm.facts: Two sablé layers, raspberry chocolate crémeux, chocolate glaze, raspberry and pistachio accents.

cal-paris.title: Callebaut: Ruby raspberry pistachio Paris-Brest
cal-paris.facts: Choux with ruby cream, raspberry and pistachio praline.

kab-choux.title: King Arthur: Cream puffs and éclairs
kab-choux.facts: Choux geometry differs for round puffs and elongated éclairs; pastry-cream filling and chocolate top icing.

kab-lemon.title: King Arthur: Lemon Cloud Cake
kab-lemon.facts: Two cake layers, lemon pastry cream and whipped lemon cream; 8-inch square or 9-inch round pans.

kab-forest.title: King Arthur: Black Forest Cake
kab-forest.facts: Chocolate cake, cherry filling, whipped cream and chocolate decoration.

kab-tiramisu.title: King Arthur: Tiramisu
kab-tiramisu.facts: Coffee-soaked sponge or ladyfingers alternate with mascarpone filling.

mdc-opera.title: Meilleur du Chef: CAP Opéra
mdc-opera.facts: Almond Joconde, coffee syrup, coffee buttercream and chocolate ganache form thin alternating layers.

mdc-fraisier.title: Meilleur du Chef: Fraisier
mdc-fraisier.facts: Génoise, mousseline, strawberries and almond-paste finish.

cap-fraisier.title: French Baccalaureat professionnel pastry examination, 2013: Fraisier
cap-fraisier.facts: Published 20 cm diameter and 4.5 cm ring height; génoise, mousseline, strawberries, optional kirsch syrup.

laf-love.title: LaFuong: Roll in Love
laf-love.facts: 14 cm heart, 5 cm tall; chocolate sponge, vanilla crémeux, wild-strawberry jam, chocolate mousse, mirror glaze.

lad-macaron.title: Ladurée: macaron flavours
lad-macaron.facts: Almond shells; distinct chocolate ganache, raspberry jam, pistachio buttercream, vanilla cream and salted-caramel fillings.

wil-mini.title: Wilton: Mini yellow cakes
wil-mini.facts: Small layer cakes use buttercream and sprinkles.

wil-stack.title: Wilton: tier construction
wil-stack.facts: Separate cake boards and cut support dowels carry upper tiers; stacking is a structural system.

ifl-method.title: Interflora: hand-tied and container arrangements
ifl-method.facts: Hand-tied bouquets use a loose spiral; container arrangements use floral foam; hatboxes are filled with blooms.

ifl-season.title: Interflora: seasonal flowers
ifl-season.facts: Seasonality refers to UK outdoor production, rather than guaranteed local or imported availability.

ifl-species.title: Interflora: flower guide
ifl-species.facts: Species have distinct forms; spring tulips, summer peonies and autumn chrysanthemums are differentiated.

ifl-peony.title: Interflora: peony guide
ifl-peony.facts: Peonies are large focal blooms; garden roses, hydrangeas and dahlias are alternatives outside their season.

ifl-spring.title: Interflora: spring wedding flowers
ifl-spring.facts: Spring examples include anemones, ranunculus, tulips, peonies, sweet peas, hyacinths, lilac and muscari.

da-taffeta.title: David Austin: Pink Taffeta
da-taffeta.facts: Keira roses with Ranunculus Elegance Rosa and Anemone Mistral Panda Blush; mixed blooms grouped around roses.

da-winter.title: David Austin: winter bouquets
da-winter.facts: Leonora roses combined with ranunculus, lilac, astrantia, hellebore and trailing foliage.

da-summer.title: David Austin: summer bridal bouquets
da-summer.facts: Ivory garden roses with yellow butterfly ranunculus form loose, directional bouquets.

gia-set.title: GIA: engagement-ring settings
gia-set.facts: Solitaire, prong, bezel and halo constructions differ in how they support the centre and melee stones.

gia-bearing.title: GIA: prong quality benchmarks
gia-bearing.facts: Prong bearings match stone contour without gaps; prong contact is a structural constraint.

stuller-set.title: Stuller: wedding-band constructions
stuller-set.facts: Channel walls carry adjacent stones; bezel surrounds girdle; shared prongs retain two neighbouring stones.

node-trudy.title: Nodeform: Trudy bezel trilogy
node-trudy.facts: 7 mm centre with 3×3 mm trillion sides; band 4.9 mm, bottom thickness 1.8 mm, shoulder 2.1 mm; height 5.4 mm.

node-bypass.title: Nodeform: alexandrite bypass solitaire
node-bypass.facts: Bypass shoulders join an encircling bezel; multiple precious-metal options.

tif-pendant.title: Tiffany: bezel diamond pendant
tif-pendant.facts: Fine chain connected to a bezel-set diamond in platinum.

tif-catalogue.title: Tiffany: engagement catalogue
tif-catalogue.facts: Solitaire, pavé, halo and graduated three-stone arrangements with round, oval, emerald and baguette cuts.

cartier-trinity.title: Cartier: Trinity construction
cartier-trinity.facts: Three separate interlinked mobile bands use yellow, white and rose gold.

rio-chain.title: Rio Grande: chain construction guide
rio-chain.facts: Cable links alternate planes; curb links twist flat; Figaro repeats a long link with three to five short links; anchor adds a crossbar.

rio-clasp.title: Rio Grande: clasps
rio-clasp.facts: Lobster and ring clasps connect to jump rings and chain end fittings.

gia-diamond.facts: Mineral identity and optical properties from the GIA gem encyclopedia.

gia-ruby.title: GIA: Рубин
gia-ruby.facts: Mineral identity and optical properties from the GIA gem encyclopedia.

gia-emerald.title: GIA: Изумруд
gia-emerald.facts: Mineral identity and optical properties from the GIA gem encyclopedia.

gia-aquamarine.title: GIA: Аквамарин
gia-aquamarine.facts: Mineral identity and optical properties from the GIA gem encyclopedia.

gia-amethyst.title: GIA: Аметист
gia-amethyst.facts: Mineral identity and optical properties from the GIA gem encyclopedia.

gia-opal.title: GIA: Опал
gia-opal.facts: Mineral identity and optical properties from the GIA gem encyclopedia.

gia-sapphire.title: GIA: Сапфир
gia-sapphire.facts: Published mineral refractive-index range; scalar IOR is its approximate midpoint.

gia-citrine.title: GIA: Цитрин
gia-citrine.facts: Published mineral refractive-index range; scalar IOR is its approximate midpoint.

gia-topaz.title: GIA: Топаз
gia-topaz.facts: Published mineral refractive-index range; scalar IOR is its approximate midpoint.

rhs-hydrangea.title: RHS: Hydrangea macrophylla
rhs-hydrangea.facts: Mophead hydrangea has a clustered flower head.

rhs-dahlia.title: RHS: dahlia forms
rhs-dahlia.facts: Cultivar classes include cactus, ball, collarette and other distinct ray-floret arrangements.

rhs-pea.title: RHS: annual sweet peas
rhs-pea.facts: Pea-like flowers in white, pink, coral, red, violet and blue; individual plant stems used for cut flowers.

kab-cupcakes.title: King Arthur: commercial cupcake constructions
kab-cupcakes.facts: Tiramisu cupcakes use coffee-soaked vanilla cake with mascarpone frosting; Boston cream cupcakes use pastry cream and ganache.

kab-doughnut.title: King Arthur: Baked Doughnuts Three Ways
kab-doughnut.facts: Baked ring doughnuts with sugar or thin icing; the central hole is preserved.

kab-cookie.title: King Arthur: decorating cookies
kab-cookie.facts: Cut-out cookies with thin sugar icing and small edible sprinkles.

kab-brownie.title: King Arthur: Fudge Brownies
kab-brownie.facts: Dense chocolate brownies with a crackled surface; published portion size 2 inches.

cal-velvet.title: Callebaut Chocolate Academy: velvet temperature
cal-velvet.facts: Chocolate spray creates a fine textured velvet finish on chilled cakes and pastries.

luther-stack.title: Luthers Diamonds: three separate stacking bands
luther-stack.facts: Separate yellow, white and rose gold bands can be stacked or worn individually; no interpenetrating geometry is required.

tif-stud.title: Tiffany: Solitaire stud earrings
tif-stud.facts: Round brilliant stones in metal baskets; matching pair of post earrings.

tif-tennis.title: Tiffany: diamond tennis bracelets
tif-tennis.facts: Flexible line bracelets carry repeated round brilliant diamonds.

tif-hoop.title: Tiffany: gold hoop earrings
tif-hoop.facts: Hoop earrings have a wearable closure rather than a decorative closed annulus.

rhs-astrantia.title: RHS: Astrantia major morphology
rhs-astrantia.facts: Branched upright stems carry compact umbels surrounded by conspicuous bracts; leaf shape and branching differ from a generic foliage spray.

umich-sweetpea.title: University of Michigan: Lathyrus odoratus morphology
umich-sweetpea.facts: The pea flower has one standard, two wing petals and a keel formed by two joined petals; flowers occur in small groups.

rhs-ivy.title: RHS: Hedera morphology
rhs-ivy.facts: Ivy foliage varies by species and growth phase; lobed juvenile leaves are appropriate for a trailing ivy model.
